name: Buffet Willie
source:
Take a trip on the Buffet Willie down the Mississippi and meet some new friends along the way.

[From [url=https://axxisproductions.itch.io/buffet-willie]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
搭上「自助威利號」，順著密西西比河而下，一路結識新朋友。

（來源：[url=https://axxisproductions.itch.io/buffet-willie]itch.io[/url]）
